title: Thai Chicken Crumble Dumplings
description: A unique fusion of Chinese dumplings filled with a mixture of chicken, falafel, and Thai spices, topped with a crumbly mixture for a crunchy texture.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine chicken, falafel mix, Thai red curry paste, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Mix well.
2. Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface. Place a small amount of the chicken mixture in the center of the wrapper.
3. Brush the edges of the wrapper with water.
4. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
5. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
6. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
7. In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
8. When the oil is hot, add the dumplings and cook until the bottoms are golden brown.
9. Add enough water to cover the dumplings and bring to a boil.
10. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the dumplings are cooked through.
11. In a small bowl, mix together cornstarch and water until smooth.
12. Stir the cornstarch mixture into the dumpling broth and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
13. Serve the dumplings hot, topped with crumbled falafel and scallions.
